answer: Every new agent must post a 2,000 POA joining bond: 60% is burned at once and 40% stays locked for a 12-epoch horizon, so a fake identity sinks 1,200 POA before earning anything. Rewards in that window are capped at 800 POA per identity, a negative delta of 400 POA per sybil — the more fakes spawned, the deeper the loss. A lone knoll of fresh identities funded from one wallet is easy to spot, so the burn rises to 85% when over 50 identities share a funding source. Edge case: a rich attacker may accept the loss to skew votes; mitigation: voting weight stays zero until the bond unlocks.
